contract: Visible read-only Mesh Quality properties and femmesh.quality.readiness expose Unchecked versus Known failed; no positive qualification channel is invented.

Known failed means the named native diagnostic criterion was observed; a Gmsh warning is not a CalculiX nonpositive-Gauss-point verdict, nor proof of the final optimized stage unless the log establishes that stage.
Zero mesher/solver exit, mesh import and input writing do not establish positive quality. No automatic writer/solver bypass or numerical acceptance is added.
Evidence includes diagnostic text/hash, command, executable hash when available, FreeCAD version, exitcode, scope, ID namespace and exact input fingerprint.

Native QProcess output is observed without consumption; raw logs and existing failure/highlighting behavior remain. Changed solver input retains historical diagnostics without highlighting unrelated IDs.
Mesh, geometry and meshing-control changes invalidate current evidence; cold restore explicitly makes IDs historical because persistence can renumber elements.
limits: Diagnostic readiness only, not a quality engine or structural/design qualification. Installed+187 remains unchanged pending final combined build.
